newsitem.title: BELGIUM: ASTRA SATELLITES REACH 67 MLN HOMES - OPERATOR.
newsitem.headline: ASTRA SATELLITES REACH 67 MLN HOMES - OPERATOR.

text.p: The ASTRA satellite system now reaches 67 million homes in Europe, a rise by 5.6 million or nine percent in 1996, Societe Europeenne des Satellites (SES), the system's private operator said on Friday.

By far the biggest penetration is in Germany, where nearly 28 million households take the system, followed by 6.3 million in the Netherlands, 5.5 million in the United Kingdom, 4.1 million in Belgium and 2.6 million in Switzerland.
SES said that to meet demand it would significantly increase the transmission capacity of the ASTRA system with the launch of four more satellites to add to the six already in orbit.
